title: [main] feature 624914 - Refactor depreciation calculation logic to use GetDepreciationCalculationBase for improved clarity and maintainability
summary: Czech Fixed Asset Localization adds an optional checkbox to deduct ending book value from the depreciation base, supporting residual-value treatment under new accounting requirements while preserving existing behavior by default.
key_points: New 'Include Ending Book Value in Depreciation Base' checkbox in Fixed Asset Setup for Czech localization
When enabled, reduces applicable depreciation base by ending book value before calculation
Respects individual and default ending book values, with ignoring options for tax depreciation groups
Disabled by default to maintain backward compatibility with existing calculations
Depreciation formulas affected only on subsequent calculations; posted entries remain unchanged
